The site at 158 Borough Drive is located within a transit-oriented community and just steps away from Scarborough Centre Subway station. The new development is zoned for 687 housing units, with 207 of those being affordable rental units.

Supporting the vision for Scarborough Centre as a vibrant and sustainable transit-oriented community, where you can live, work and play; 
Design that is sensitive to the existing context of Scarborough Centre, ...[cut for the sample]

proposed_use.value: A new mixed-income development located within a transit-oriented community neighbouring the Scarborough Civic Centre and Scarborough Town Centre.

summary.value: The 158 Borough Drive project neighbours the Scarborough Civic Centre and Scarborough Town Centre and will bring a new mixed-income development to this area of the city that will deliver 687 housing units, including affordable rental units.

surrounding_use.value: The site abuts the Scarborough Civic Centre to the west, to the north of the site is the Scarborough Town Centre, SRT stop and residential, to the east is residential and to the south is the Frank Faubent Wood Lot .

The project site, made up of 1631-1641 Queen Street East, 1090 Eastern Avenue and a portion of 1080 Eastern Avenue, sits north of Woodbine Park and along the TTC’s 501 streetcar line in the Beaches-East York neighbourhood.
The new mixed-income, mixed-use development will deliver approximately 328 new rental homes, including approximately 99 affordable rental units. summary.value: Located in the Beaches-East York neighbourhood, 1631 Queen Street East is a mixed-income, mixed-use development. The project is targeted to deliver approximately 328 new homes, including approximately 99 affordable rental units, as well as a new Indigenous placekeeping space at Kishigo Lane.

Located in a prime location in Toronto's Central Waterfront, 190 Cherry Street was previously the site of Go-Karts at Polson Pier, and has been used as a surface parking lot since 2020. However, an application has been submitted to transform the site into a new 3-storey Porsche automotive dealership and service shop and a cafe.
